title: NBA veteran statistics for the June 26, 2003 career checkpoint
description: Data collection format for statistical player ratings. Start with 2002-03 regular-season Totals and Advanced tables for all players, including low-minute players. Earlier completed seasons and shooting-distance splits are optional. NBA only; exclude the incoming 2003 draft class, college statistics, playoffs, and all 2003-04 or later results. Provide observed statistics, not assigned ratings. Nullable fields allow partial submissions; passing this schema does not mean every player is ready to rate.
$comment: Collection rules: (1) season_end_year 2003 means 2002-03; 2002 means 2001-02. (2) All totals are season totals, never per-game or per-36. (3) All percentage fields are fractions: 55%=0.55 and 24.5%=0.245. FTr is FTA/FGA and may exceed 1; TS% can also exceed 1. (4) Null means unavailable or undefined, never zero. Missing from a table does not prove zero appearances. Explain missing data in notes. (5) One combined season row per verified player; do not include both combined and team-stint rows. (6) Do not estimate missing data or use later performance. (7) Full league exports are preferred to qualified-player leaderboards. (8) Sources: https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2003_totals.html ; https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2003_advanced.html ; optional https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2003_shooting.html ; optional league averages https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2003.html . Import checks beyond JSON Schema: verify identities and unique player/season keys, source dates and definitions, makes <= attempts, starts <= games, PTS = 2*(FG-3P)+3*3P+FT, valid zero-game rows, and numerical agreement between totals and rates. A low-sample estimate remains an estimate. Reference definitions: https://www.basketball-reference.com/about/glossary.html .

dataset_kind.description: Change to collected_stats when submitting real records. Templates are not rating inputs.

as_of_date.description: Career knowledge cutoff. This is not the retrieval date.

league_averages.description: Optional. One entry for each completed season whose league averages were collected.

estimated_rate.description: An estimated rate expressed as a fraction. Usually between 0 and 1. Preserve and flag an unusual source estimate rather than clipping it; tiny samples and estimated denominators can produce outliers. Do not confuse 24.5% with the number 24.5: enter 0.245.

fraction.description: A fraction, not percentage points: 24.5% is 0.245. Null if unknown or undefined.

season_end_year.description: Ending calendar year of the completed season. 2003 = 2002-03. Collect 2003 first; 2002 and 2001 are useful additional history. Do not substitute future seasons.

url.description: Exact source page or downloadable file URL. Do not invent a URL.

retrieved_on.description: Optional retrieval date. Modern retrieval is allowed; the statistics must describe seasons completed before the career cutoff.

notes.description: Optional table location, alternate definitions, or source limitations.

games.description: G. Games played in this regular season. Zero means confirmed no appearances.

minutes.description: MP. TOTAL minutes played, not minutes per game. Preserve source precision.

field_goals_made.description: FG. Total field goals made, including three-pointers.

field_goals_attempted.description: FGA. Total field goal attempts, including three-pointers.

totals.description: Raw regular-season totals. Keep all keys; use null where unavailable. Shooting percentages and per-game averages can be calculated later from these totals.

true_shooting_pct.description: TS%. Copy a source decimal such as .550 as 0.550. Can exceed 1 in unusual small samples.

usage_pct.description: USG%. Convert source percentage points to a fraction: 24.5 becomes 0.245. This measures plays used, not touches or overall ability.

block_pct.description: BLK%. Convert 3.0 to 0.030. Use the Basketball-Reference definition, based on opponent two-point attempts.

three_point_attempt_rate.description: 3PAr = 3PA / FGA. Copy a source decimal such as .250 as 0.250. This is shot frequency, not shooting accuracy.

free_throw_attempt_rate.description: FTr = FTA / FGA. Copy the source decimal. This ratio may exceed 1. It is not FT%, and is not FTM / FGA.

advanced.description: Copy sourced advanced rates, using the field-specific unit instructions. Basketball-Reference displays USG%, AST%, ORB%, DRB%, STL%, BLK%, and TOV% as percentage points; divide those by 100. TS%, 3PAr and FTr are already displayed as decimals. If another provider uses different definitions, identify them in source notes.

zone.description: Use the source shooting-distance buckets. Do not combine rim attempts with other two-pointers.

fga_share.description: Share of ALL field goal attempts taken from this zone. Copy the source decimal.

fg_pct.description: Field goal percentage within this zone, as a fraction. Null if no attempts or unavailable.

attempts.description: Optional exact attempt count, if directly available. Do not reconstruct an integer from a rounded share.

makes.description: Optional exact made-shot count, if directly available.

player_name.description: Full name as shown in the source.

bbr_id.description: Verified Basketball-Reference player ID from the player URL, without .html. Null if unresolved; never guess from the name.

team_codes.description: Teams represented by these season statistics, such as ["SEA", "MIL"]. Use [] when unknown or there were no appearances. Never put TOT or 2TM here.

sources.description: Sources for this record. Use the table field to identify what each URL supports. Empty is allowed only in the blank collection template.

shooting_by_distance.description: Optional. Include only sourced zones. Add a shooting source to this record. Do not fill missing zones with estimates.

notes.description: Explain unavailable fields, no appearances, incomplete source coverage, or identity uncertainty. Do not add ratings, inferred development, or future career facts.

record.description: Exactly one combined regular-season row per player per season. For traded players, use the source aggregate season row, often labelled TOT or 2TM; do not also submit the individual team stints. Do not average team percentages.

pace.description: Pace. Team possessions per 48 minutes, using the source definition.

fg_pct.description: League FG% as a fraction, calculated from league makes and attempts.

three_pct.description: League 3P% as a fraction, calculated from league makes and attempts.

ft_pct.description: League FT% as a fraction, calculated from league makes and attempts.

league_averages.description: Optional league calibration data. Use league aggregates for that season, not an unweighted average of player rates. All counting averages here are per TEAM per GAME; pace is per 48 minutes.
